Treat XML/SVG nodes as tensor-shaped data. <path d='...'> = polyline tensor; transform='matrix(...)' = affine map; custom data-* attrs = embedding coordinates. XML nodes act as MoE gating layers; layer-skipping routes inference straight to the relevant transform. Hardware-accelerated SVG filters in Chromium = the GPU compositor runtime. Uses parser_cursor as the engine pattern.

Foundation for Pinterest mass harvest where 100 pins of similar shapes get clustered into 1 family with 100 attribute variants.
